faq.h2: Before we plan the first day.
items: Where do you operate?
Across the Alps: in Switzerland, Austria, France, Italy and Germany. And in Las Leñas, in the Argentine Andes, for the southern winter. [See all destinations](/destinations/).
What can a trip include?
Private coaching, hotels and chalets, dining, wellness, guiding and transfers. Every part is optional: some guests come for a single lesson, others for a full week we handle from start to finish.
Why plan the stay through you rather than directly with the hotel?

With many of our hotels we work under our own agreements, so the stay usually costs you the same or less than taking it directly at the hotel's list price. And you get the rest with it: we know these mountains and the people who run them, we build the week around your group, and we are there when something needs sorting out.
What does planning with you cost?
There is no separate planning fee: your proposal is one plan for the week, stay included. Coaching, guiding and the days we host are part of that proposal.
Do you show prices?
No. Every trip is planned for you, so we send a proposal with the costs once we know your dates, your group and what you want to do. A first proposal within 24 hours of your enquiry.
How fast do you answer?
Within one working day, often straight away. A first proposal within 24 hours.
Do I need a finished plan to get in touch?
No. Start with whatever you know, a date, a group or an idea of the day, and we come back with the questions that matter and one clear proposal.
How far ahead should I write?
As early as you can for February and Easter, when the good houses go first; a week outside the holidays can come together at short notice.
Who provides the stay itself?
EverFlow is your contact before and during the trip. The hotel or the owner provides the stay under its own terms; every stay page says who.
Do you arrange lift passes, transfers, ski school and equipment?
Yes, wherever you want them in the plan; in LAAX the lift passes are ready to collect at the ticket desks.
Do you take beginners and children?
Yes: coaching runs from first days to race technique, and [the family guide](/guides/ski-week-with-kids/) shows how a week is built around children.
Which languages do you host in?
English, Spanish and Portuguese, with German-speaking instructors and partners across the Alps.

about.title: About EverFlow Experience
about.description: EverFlow Experience is a boutique alpine travel company founded in 2022 by Juan Rodrigo Fernandez, a former member of the Argentinian Ski Team. Hosted across the Alps.
about.h1: The days you remember are the ones built around you.
story: EverFlow Experience was founded in 2022 by Juan Rodrigo Fernandez, a former member of the Argentinian Ski Team. What began as a ski school has grown into complete, tailor-made alpine trips.
From private coaching on snow to hotels, chalets, dining, wellness and transfers, every trip is planned around one group at a time, with local knowledge and the mountain culture of each place.
We host across the Alps. Our trips are multilingual and fully tailored: race-honed technique, and the kind of hosting that turns a trip into a story people want to tell.
about.how_text: We host, plan and coordinate. On the mountain we work with licensed instructors and guides, and with local partners where the rules of a country require it, so the standard is the same in every destination. EverFlow Experience is a member of the German Ski Instructors Association (DSLV).
about.credential_alt: Profi Ski: award of the German Ski Instructors Association (DSLV) for ski schools
